Client Experience Architecture

Homeowner Journey: Find → Compare → Evaluate → Book

Homeowners in Delhi NCR face significant uncertainty regarding architectural credentials, unpredictable fees, and unsolicited sales pitches. The Vastoco Client Homepage replaces ambiguity with structured clarity and upfront transparency.

Client Desktop Homepage 1440px Viewport
Desktop Hero & Quick Discovery: High-impact architectural focal point with instant locality, discipline, and typology search. Sample cards feature real portfolio visuals, transparent consultation pricing, and verified practice credentials.
Client Mobile Homepage 390px Viewport
Mobile Adaptations: Full-width vertical card stacking without horizontal overflow. Single-tap category filtering, touch-optimized consultation duration pills, and streamlined upfront fee reviews.
Feature Implementation Details Official Brief Alignment
Verified Disciplines Architects, Interior Designers, and Vastu Consultants clearly separated with custom iconography. Satisfies official professional category breakdown for Delhi NCR.
Consultation Tiers 15 min (Discovery), 30 min (Technical Scope), and 45 min (Masterplanning) with upfront fees. Exact match to the 3 mandatory paid video consultation tiers.
Trust & Zero-Fakes Only genuine consultation reviews are eligible; zero fake ratings or fabricated 5-star badges. Adheres strictly to content integrity and zero fabricated metric rules.

Professional Experience Architecture

Professional Mobile Homepage 390px Viewport

Pillar Specification Commercial Rationale
85% Fee Retention Professionals keep 85% of each consultation fee; 15% deducted by Vastoco. Transparent monetization without hidden monthly platform subscriptions.
COA Verification Check Council of Architecture check for registered architects; qualification checks for designers. Establishes verifiable authority without claiming automated instant approvals.
Direct Client Briefs Homeowners specify project budget, scope (renovation/new build), and timeline upfront. Eliminates low-intent inquiries and speculative free design requests.

Design System · Brand, Typography & Tokens

Design System & Two-Colour Discipline

Strict Two-Colour Palette & Architectural Editorial Direction

In strict accordance with the brand challenge, all third hues (teals, greens, oranges, purples, pure white, pure black) were systematically eliminated. Depth, hierarchy, and elevation are achieved entirely through opacity variations of Espresso and Pale Oak.

Espresso #3C2415 · rgb(60, 36, 21) Primary typography, structural frames, solid CTA buttons, high-contrast borders.
Pale Oak #DDD9CE · rgb(221, 217, 206) Base canvas, cards, inverted badge text, subtle architectural drafting overlays.

Typography

Playfair Display & Inter

Headings: Playfair Display (weights 400, 600, 700) provides editorial architectural elegance.
Interface: Inter (weights 400, 500, 600, 700) provides clean legibility for dense UI labels, inputs, and navigation.

Spacing Scale

8px Structural Grid

Harmonic 8px scale: 4px, 8px, 12px, 16px, 24px, 32px, 48px, 64px, 88px, 112px.
Max content constraint: 1200px centered with responsive fluid side gutters.

Contrast & a11y

11.2:1 WCAG AAA

Espresso on Pale Oak exceeds the 7.0:1 AAA standard.
Zero red/green status coding; error states utilize explicit warning copy, icons, and high-contrast border weights.

Asset Processing & Geometry

Asset Format & Weight Brand Treatment & Integrity
Vastoco Logo PNG · 4.1 KB Original geometry 100% preserved. Rendered in monochrome Espresso (#3C2415) with zero teal hue.
Architectural Cutaway WebP · 74.3 KB Duotone processed into exact #3C2415 and #DDD9CE channel map. Zero CSS filter artifacts.
